label: Glorfindel completes
criterion: Applies to every /glorfindel invocation. ✓ the run closes with a STIRRED or QUIET verdict token · ✗ the run ends with neither token (the sweep did not finish, or the verdict was never rendered).

label: Aulë completes
criterion: Applies to every /aule invocation. ✓ the run closes with a STIRRED or QUIET verdict token · ✗ neither token appears (the forge sweep did not reach its verdict).

label: Anduin completes
criterion: Applies to every /anduin invocation. ✓ the run closes with a STIRRED or QUIET verdict token · ✗ neither token appears (the council→forge pipeline did not finish).

label: Council posts counsel
criterion: Applies to every /council invocation. ✓ a [COUNSEL] marker appears in the main-thread run · ✗ none appears. Note: Erestor posts [COUNSEL] to the tracker via a subagent, so main-thread-only runs read low here.

label: Celebrimbor forges
criterion: Applies to every /celebrimbor invocation. ✓ a [GWAITH] marker appears in the main-thread run · ✗ none appears. Note: the smith posts [GWAITH] through a subagent, so main-thread-only runs read low here.

label: Mithrandir renders a verdict
criterion: Applies to every /mithrandir invocation. ✓ the run renders a Merge, Hold, or Refuse bottom-line · ✗ none of the three appears (the review did not reach a verdict).

label: Mandos pronounces
criterion: Applies to every /mandos invocation. ✓ the run pronounces Covered, Missing, or Scope-crept · ✗ none of the three appears (the doom was never spoken).

label: Board serves
criterion: Applies to every /board invocation. ✓ the run prints a http://localhost: URL (the server booted or was reused) · ✗ no URL is surfaced (the board never came up).

label: User prompt clean (no grammar note drawn — measures the user's typing, not the model)
criterion: Applies to every genuine user prompt. ✓ the reply drew no grammar note (the prompt was clean) · ✗ a > **Grammar:** correction was appended. This measures the user's typing, not the model.

label: Free-form edit carries the Task Sizing gauge
criterion: Applies to free-form runs that mutate the tree (no slash-command frame). ✓ a 'Size ▰…' gauge appears in the narration before the first edit · ✗ the run edited with no gauge shown first.

label: Free-form edit names Acceptance before touching the tree
criterion: Applies to free-form runs that mutate the tree. ✓ the word 'Acceptance' appears in the narration before the first edit · ✗ the run edited without naming acceptance criteria first.

label: Free-form edit is preceded by a summary (Change Approval)
criterion: Applies to free-form runs that mutate the tree. ✓ some narration precedes the first edit (the run did not jump straight to editing) · ✗ the first assistant turn edited with no summary before it.

label: Compliance Review dispatches an agent and renders a verdict closing a mutating task segment
criterion: Applies once per mutating task segment (consecutive edits + read-only wind-down), for segments dated on or after 2026-07-16. ✓ a 'Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL' line follows the segment's last edit AND an Agent review was dispatched at or before it · ✗ the marker is missing, or it was typed with no review agent spawned.

label: Plan accepted as proposed
criterion: Applies to every run where a task-size gauge was rendered and answered — never to a run that owed no gauge, so an exempt slash-command run cannot count as a miss. ✓ the user let the plan proceed as proposed · ✗ the user altered the scope or approach, or declined. A gate walked away from is excluded from both sides and reported as an abandoned count — silence is no verdict on a plan. A gate no judge could answer is likewise absent rather than guessed. Every gate is judged, including those the user answered by picking an option the gate offered: the judge weighs which option was chosen, because passing those through as acceptance would pin a tenth of the denominator at 100% by construction. The call is made by a model and cached per gate, so it reads intent rather than keywords; it is still a judgment, hence the heuristic tier.

label: Task lands first-shot — no correction-toned rework runs in its segment (model capability, not a config rule)
rework: (?i)\b(wrong|revert|undo|redo|broken)\b|^\s*(no|nope|nah|nvm|not|still|didn'?t|doesn'?t|isn'?t)\b|不對|不行|重來|改回|退回|(?<!不)錯
criterion: Measures the model, not a config rule. Applies once per task segment. ✓ the task landed with no more than the threshold (0) correction-toned rework runs — the user did not come back to fix it · ✗ a follow-up opened with a correction (leading 'no/not/still', or 'wrong/revert/不對/錯' anywhere), meaning the model missed. Additive follow-ups ('also commit and push') do not count. Read the byModel split; the tone match is a heuristic, so the row reads slightly optimistic.

label: Commit bears the session footer
criterion: Pending — the git probe is not built yet. When live: ✓ the commit body carries a Claude-Session: footer · ✗ it does not.

label: PR/MR self-assigned
criterion: Pending — the forge probe is not built yet. When live: ✓ the PR/MR is self-assigned to the author at creation · ✗ it was left unassigned.
